Summons a creation of darkness to aid you. The Nightwalker is an ancient companion of the Invader Cabal, possessing some clan skills and able to supply Invaders with special dark cookies :)
The power of the summoned clan creature depends on your {hh3clan rank{x.
{CATTRIBUTES{x {C%A%{x {hh63Summoned creature{x, needs =re-subjugation= after {hh992leaving{x the world {C%A%{x Can be summoned only at night (by day too with the clan upgrade below) {C%A%{x Summoned for a week {C%A%{x Can be given a weapon and shield {C%A%{x Maximum one can be controlled at a time, summoned one at a time The total number of {hh15followers{x is also limited -- see {y{hchelp charm{x.
